rows.section: Cantonal income tax tariff (Obwalden, Rate in force (no start date stated))
rows.label: Simple tax: rate on the whole taxable income
rows.basis: Taxable income, per year (simple tax, before the multipliers)
rows.note: Tariff vintage: Rate in force (no start date stated), per ESTV Kantonsblatt (Stand Februar 2026).

rows.value: Amounts below CHF 100 are not taken into account

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Sarnen; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Sarnen; other communes in Obwalden set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.label: Profit tax rate, companies and cooperatives (one rate shared between canton, municipality and church)
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Obwalden (Stand Februar 2026), Juristische Personen: Steuerberechnung, Art. 87 StG

rows.label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer)
rows.value: None in the cantonal tax law: the land taxes it provides are the property gains tax and the transfer tax
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: Obwalden Steuergesetz (StG, GDB 641.4), Stand 1. Januar 2026, Art. 142 and the minimum tax on real estate

rows.label: Minimum tax on real estate
rows.value: A fixed minimum tax of 2 per mille of the net tax value of real estate replaces the ordinary taxes where it is higher (legal entities and natural persons)
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: Obwalden Steuergesetz (StG, GDB 641.4), Stand 1. Januar 2026, Art. 142 and the minimum tax on real estate

rows.label: Transfer tax rate (share of the property value)
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Obwalden Steuergesetz (StG, GDB 641.4), Stand 1. Januar 2026, Art. 158-163

rows.label: Who pays
rows.value: Seller and buyer, half each, unless agreed otherwise (yield shared half and half between canton and municipality)
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Obwalden Steuergesetz (StG, GDB 641.4), Stand 1. Januar 2026, Art. 158-163
